description: Exact symbolic local implicit-function reduction of the original six-canonical-pair secondary to a regular first-order f-momentum ODE on two-primary dust shell
method: For prescribed curved metric/matter phase/shift and g-sector primary data, eliminate f-dust lapse momentum p_f and f radial canonical momentum pS_f using original H_f=0 and D_f=-D_g. Substitute into analytic physical C=K00-(K01)' from exact Step45; C is exactly affine in V=pLf'(r).

exact_formulas.primary_f_pf: pf= -( Lf*pLf^2/(4Mf2*Sf^2) - [pLf/(2Mf2 Sf Sf_prime)]*(-Dg+Lf*V) - Mf2*Lf*Sf^2*R3f/2 + z*Dg/Lf + Wf )/(sqrt(1+(theta_f_prime/Lf)^2)+[pLf/(2Mf2 Sf Sf_prime)]*theta_f_prime)
exact_formulas.first_order_equation: V=pLf'(r)=-C0/C1 where C0 is C(r) after primary elimination evaluated at V=0

strict_identity_tests: Full C derivative wrt pSf equals explicit At interaction coefficient
Primary-eliminated C is AFFINE in V; second V derivative exactly zero
Affine coefficient equals exact factorized expression
Symbolic substitution V=-C0/C1 gives C identically zero
regularity_conditions: For r>0 in the certified Step40/42 spatial chart: Lg,Lf,Sf,Sf_prime,At= Sg^2 J(eta), Mg2,Mf2,m2 positive; |z|<1, beta_f>0 and dust_coef_f>0; hence C1<0 and locally smooth. ODE is standard local initial-value equation; a local solution follows with suitable regular prescribed fields/data (not global).
next_step47: Start IVP at r0>0 from frozen Step41 pLf(r0), integrate exact analytic ODE, independently verify original unsmeared primaries and C at off-fit radii and seek rigorous interval positivity; analyze regular singular center r=0 and boundary conditions. Then time-preservation of exact secondary with all 6 canonical pairs.
notes: The symbolic local ODE reduction is not yet a full dynamical solution; other prescribed fields and g-primary must remain consistent, and first variation holds with external z on Fz=0.
